title: South-West Development Commission (Establishment) Act, 2025
gazette_number: Federal Republic of Nigeria Official Gazette / Act No. 8 of 2025
description: An Act to establish the South-West Development Commission charged with the responsibility to receive and manage funds allocated from the Federation Account for the infrastructure and ecological development of the South-West zone.

sections.section_title: Establishment of the South-West Development Commission
sections.part: Part I - Establishment of the Commission and the Governing Board
sections.full_text:
(1) There is established the South-West Development Commission (in this Act referred to as "the Commission").
(2) The Commission —
(a) is a body corporate with perpetual succession and a common seal; and
(b) may sue and be sued in its corporate name.
(3) The headquarters of the Commission shall be in Ibadan, Oyo State.

sections.part: Part I - Establishment of the Commission and the Governing Board
sections.full_text:
(1) There is established for the Commission a Governing Board representing Ekiti, Lagos, Ogun, Ondo, Osun, and Oyo States.
(2) The Board shall consist of a Chairman, state representatives, security agencies, and executive management.
